subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Some students were shocked.”?
options: A new classmate, Ravi, brought lunch that smelled different from what other students usually ate.
But it became popular because people learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression.
Later, they learned that many students who did not usually speak loudly had voted for them.
Months later, the old tree was gone, but the bench was always full of students.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some students were shocked. Later, they learned that many students who did not usually speak loudly had voted for them.」，答案為「Later, they learned that many students who did not usually speak loudly had voted for them.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Later, they learned that many students who did not usually speak loudly had voted for them.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
